Attached is Redwood's consolidated redline: OrderForm_v3_redline_Redwood.docx. Summary of changes and position:
- EU-hosting fallback: Accepted as a Transfer Addendum (Annex B) with two conditions: (a) NovaCorp provides minimum committed throughput to justify regional provisioning or agrees to a 90-day provisioning lead time for private capacity; (b) KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for EU region is required for full residency assurance.
- Subprocessor approvals: Replace unilateral approval with a 30-day notice + right-to-object for specific sensitive categories (fraud detection, data enrichment). We'll maintain a publicly available subprocessor list updated monthly.
- SCCs edits: narrow the data export definition to exclude aggregated telemetry; accept the majority of your mapping but retain Redwood's incident remediation commitments as is.
- Minor contract language: suggest alternative warranty caps tied to annual committed spend (see clause 12.3).

Asha — looping you for legal redline reconciliation and to flag the DocuSign path once we have final text. Tom / NovaCorp — can you confirm the provisioning condition above? If you accept, we'll move to signoff and I will generate the DocuSign envelope.

Quick update from engineering/security on the technical asks:
- KMS / customer-managed keys in EU: feasible. With a committed capacity order we can provision a VPC-backed private deployment in ~60 days; without committed capacity it will be closer to 120 days. The 90-day provisioning lead time Ben proposed is therefore acceptable as a middle ground.
- EU-only processing for hosted (no private): we can implement strict routing + geo-fencing for processing within EU regions for NovaCorp requests, but we need the Transfer Addendum to document fallback behaviors and acceptable egress paths.
- Log & audit: we can provide enhanced audit logs for NovaCorp (30-day retention by default; extended retention available as an add-on).

Tom — with the KMS and 90-day provisioning acceptance, are you comfortable for us to update the DPA Annex B and proceed to DocuSign? If so, Ben will send the final envelope tonight.

If you want any last-minute language edits I can coordinate with infra to make sure commitments are reflected exactly.

Thanks,
Hannah
